text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got back about 5 hours a week. Post-call admin shrank from 30 minutes to under 10.

2. CRM data got better. Next steps and decision-makers were logged on nearly every call, not just the ones reps remembered.

3. Managers coached from real moments instead of rep summaries. That changed our 1:1s.

4. Consent matters. Some customers hesitated, so we now ask upfront and always honor a "no."

5. Adoption followed trust. Reps used it more once they saw it wasn't a surveillance tool.

The tech wasn't the hard part. Clear norms were.

What's the one rule your team would set before piloting?
